_note: A region of the world (docs/WORLD_DATA.md): its box [west, south, east, north] (degrees), where a new player starts, and where its map comes from. npm run world:build -- --region sf builds assets/world/sf.pmtiles. Overture: a release on its public S3 bucket ('latest' takes the newest); osm: an OpenStreetMap extract (.osm.pbf) for this region, if you have one — roads, land use, water and details then come from it (with every OSM tag: lanes, sidewalks, trees, street lamps…), buildings from Overture either way. dem: the elevation (tools/world/dem.mjs): a region's own LiDAR elevation files first (local), then Copernicus GLO-30 everywhere (base).
name: San Francisco
